set.body:
Design authority: docs/delivery/workspace-design.md, sections 11.4; formative round. Visual references: mockups/workspace-vision-2026-09-22/README.md.
Repository owner: storyatlas4s. Delivery boundary: post-M1 / extended capability.
Integration parent: bd-01M1C2A5HGJ0MM1X7N8Z5EAZBD; parent relationship does not itself block execution.
Entry dependencies: bd-01M16KDH0TM7DF2BC0K08TH0TT.

REUSE, SCOPE AND PRESERVATION
Own predefined task protocol, representative scientist sessions and findings after first working matrix/evidence journey. Use unfamiliar admitted/synthetic text; approximately 5-8 participants is the initial target. This is human comprehension evidence, not screenshot inspection.

ACCEPTANCE AND FAILURE WITNESSES
1. Ask users to explain structure, ambiguity versus joint reference, coarse support, failure/external/untimed states, reconstructed decisions and evidence access.
2. Record task-level denominators, unaided completion, participant interpretations and critical misreadings; file bounded repairs under their owning implementation issues.
3. Unavailable recruitment remains an explicit blocker. Do not count an agent/browser script as a human participant or turn this into an extra M1 scientific gate.

EVIDENCE
Record exact producer/consumer/dependency revisions, fixture digests, actual commands/results and warnings/skips. Apply design section 11.5 and AGENTS.md to the changed runtime boundary, including compileAll testAll scalafmtCheckAll app/fastLinkJS and relevant existing/new browser courts for shell changes; use isolated siblings and session-owned project browsers. Documentation-only or human-study evidence is scoped as such. New test names are specifications until implemented and run. No inference, calibration, hosted CI, publication or release is certified by ticket creation.

FALLBACK
Keep software M1 qualification separate and report comprehension outstanding; do not claim usability from the images.

Coordinate one implementation writer and one heavy build at a time. Reserve exact paths when taking the ticket; do not claim other writers' scopes. Keep scientific operations in StoryModel, reuse this application and preserve unrelated edits.
set.title: [UX] Run early scientist comprehension tasks on the joined text workspace
